title: 拜靖国神社，日本再次撕下自己的“和平伪装”（钟声）

summary: 人民日报“钟声”文章指出，日本首相高市早苗10月17日以“内阁总理大臣”名义向靖国神社供奉祭品，19日又委托自民党高官供奉祭祀费，秋季大祭期间多名政要献祭参拜。文章批评靖国神社是军国主义精神工具，近日公开的会议记录显示日本政府曾秘密安排合祀
summary_en: A People's Daily 'Bell' article noted that Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae made offerings to Yasukuni Shrine in the name of 'Prime Minister' on Oct 17, and on Oct 19 entrusted a senior LDP official to offer ritual fees; many political figures made offerings and visits during the autumn festival. The article criticized Yasukuni Shrine as a spiritual tool of militarism, and recently disclosed meeting records showed the Japanese government had secretly arranged joint enshrinement.

Iran's president said Iran will never yield to unreasonable demands and bullying from 'aggressive' countries, and the military said response plans are in place.

summary_en: At the 140th Canton Fair, a new product debut display area was set up for the first time, showcasing innovative results such as electronic consumer goods, motorcycles, and lighting products, attracting buyers from many countries to experience and negotiate. American buyer Nicole, after trying a product with an ECG detection function, said she 'can't wait to buy some and take them back home'; the 14-gram screenless wristband from Guangzhou Haiweite has already reached... with buyers from the United States, Turkey, and other places.

title: 搭条产线，一起算算共赢账（探馆广交会）
title_en: Setting up a production line and calculating the win-win gains together (Exploring the Canton Fair)
summary: 在第140届广交会上，创维集团与俄罗斯客户合作模式从单纯出口整机转向在当地搭建生产线：创维出口冰箱、洗衣机重要零部件并派工程师指导组装，客户建厂招工，一年组装约1万台，并逐步发展本地包装、注塑等供应链，实现成本下降和带动当地就业，创维利润未
summary_en: At the 140th Canton Fair, Skyworth Group's cooperation model with Russian clients shifted from exporting complete units to setting up local production lines: Skyworth exports key components for refrigerators and washing machines and sends engineers to guide assembly; the client builds a factory and hires workers, assembling about 10,000 units a year, and gradually develops local supply chains such as packaging and injection molding, cutting costs and boosting local employment.

title_en: 5th Chinese Archaeology Congress opens in Shanxi
summary: 第五届中国考古学大会在山西省运城市开幕，由中国考古学会等主办，来自中国及美国、加拿大、英国、日本、韩国等国家的数百名考古学者参会。大会以“考古学的历史与未来”为主题，围绕中华文明起源、统一多民族国家形成与发展相关重要遗址，展示最新重大发现、
summary_en: The Fifth Chinese Archaeology Conference opened in Yuncheng, Shanxi Province, hosted by the Chinese Archaeological Society and others, with hundreds of archaeologists from China and countries including the United States, Canada, Britain, Japan and South Korea attending. Under the theme 'The History and Future of Archaeology,' the conference focused on key sites related to the origins of Chinese civilization and the formation and development of a unified multi-ethnic country, showcasing the latest major discoveries and research achievements.

title: 普埃布拉彩陶与文化交流（大千絮语）
title_en: Puebla painted pottery and cultural exchange (Global Miscellany)
summary: 普埃布拉彩陶是跨太平洋文化交流的产物。16世纪中叶西班牙开辟马尼拉至阿卡普尔科航线，中国青花瓷传入新西班牙，普埃布拉成为消费、分销与再创造节点。17至18世纪，当地陶工行会要求精品陶器模仿中国青花样式与晕染技法，陶工结合伊比利亚锡釉陶和中国
summary_en: Puebla polychrome pottery is a product of trans-Pacific cultural exchange. In the mid-16th century, Spain opened the Manila-Acapulco route, Chinese blue-and-white porcelain reached New Spain, and Puebla became a hub for consumption, distribution and re-creation. In the 17th and 18th centuries, local potters' guilds required fine ceramics to imitate Chinese blue-and-white styles and shading techniques, and potters combined Iberian tin-glazed pottery with Chinese blue-and-white techniques.
